download_route_note: Official GFC v3 page's UI-generated ies-ows route could not be reached in this environment. The official JRC LATEST/tiles/ directory provided this per-tile v4 GeoTIFF, avoiding the ~50 GB mosaic.

source_raster.nominal_pixel_size: 10 m per official JRC/Google Earth Engine catalog; raster affine step is 1/12000 degree

value_semantics.official_product_description: Spatial representation of forest presence and absence for reference year 2020 at 10 m; for EUDR use it is non-mandatory, non-exclusive and not legally binding.
value_semantics.zero_note: 0 is present in the decoded raster; the catalog describes both presence and absence but its displayed class table names only value 1. Preserve raw 0 and confirm its exact metadata label before semantic integration.

limits: This is a rectangular bbox chip, not plot-polygon statistics.
The product represents mapped forest cover for reference year 2020; it does not independently establish legal compliance or supplier declarations.
The current official page says v4 technical documentation is expected by December 2026; review version-specific methods and class definitions before semantic integration.
This v4 acquisition does not resolve availability of the requested v3 tile.
